VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device — official, unmodified driver package

Licensing: https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm
VB-CABLE is donationware; contributions are welcome. Professional use and

and is not presented as a driver authored by XingyuConnect.

Package: VBCABLE_Driver_Pack45.zip (October 2024)
SHA-256: b950e39f01af1d04ea623c8f6d8eb9b6ea5c477c637295fabf20631c85116bfb
Source: https://download.vb-audio.com/Download_CABLE/VBCABLE_Driver_Pack45.zip

The original ZIP retains the vendor's license and signed driver files unchanged.
The application extracts it and opens the official x64 installer. Installation
requires administrator authorization; the vendor requires a reboot to finalize.

Validated here: VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe and vbaudio_cable64_win10.sys have valid
publisher signatures. vbaudio_cable64_win10.cat has a valid Microsoft Windows
Hardware Compatibility Publisher signature.
